We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the described case.

Facts: Cao, logistics department head, colluded with transport company owners to have them issue false invoices (增值税专用发票?) for tax deduction. He took a percentage of transport fees as tax point money, then arranged for companies to issue false invoices for tax deduction. He delivered those invoices to his company, which used them to offset tax. So this is "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票" maybe? The list includes "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". That matches. Also could be "经济犯" but the list includes "经济犯" as a category. In earlier examples, for similar case of virtual invoices they used "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯". Let's see earlier example: The second example (吴1) they gave answer: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯". That case involved false VAT invoices used for export tax refund. Here, the invoices are used for tax deduction (抵扣税款). So same charge. Possibly also "经济犯" as a broader category. In many examples, they include both. For contract fraud they used "合同诈骗". For unit bribery they used "对非国家工作人员行贿". For bribery they used "行贿". For tax invoice fraud they used "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". In the example, they also added "经济犯". So we should output both.

Thus final answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;经济犯<eoa>
